_comment: Robustness check for the cellular-automata encoding. The original implementation seeded 768 of 1024 cells from NumPy's legacy Mersenne Twister keyed on digest_bytes[:4]; ca_shake.py derives the entire board from SHAKE-256. Identical measurement protocol: 10,000 random pairs drawn from 5,000 samples, plus 20 targets x 2,000 independent candidates.
conclusion: Unchanged. The perceptual-hash clustering of the cellular family is a property of the encoding, not an artifact of the seeding defect. The one-unit difference in best-of-M minima (4 vs 5) is within run-to-run variation on a minimum taken over 20 targets; the means (6.00 vs 5.95) agree.
